title: New FDA-cleared AI tool could help predict if breast cancer will return
key_facts: SimBioSys's TumorSight Risk, powered by NVIDIA GPUs, is FDA-cleared
It estimates the chance of breast cancer returning over 5 to 10 years, using an existing breast MRI plus pathology and clinical data
Score runs 0 to 100: low, intermediate or high risk; available before surgery
Study of 2,129 women: 95.5% of low-risk stayed cancer-free after 5 years vs 89.6% of high-risk
High-risk group had more than three times the recurrence risk of low-risk
Each 10-point rise in score linked to 22% higher relative recurrence risk
Applies to early-stage, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative cancer (about 74% of US breast cancer diagnoses per the National Cancer Institute)
SimBioSys is working with Medicare, Medicaid and private insurers on coverage
quote_evidence: TumorSight Risk doesn't require any additional scans.
Researchers analyzed data from 2,129 women and found that 95.5% of those classified as low-risk remained cancer-free after five years, compared with 89.6% of those classified as high-risk.
The company behind this new technology is working with Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurers to get the test covered.
why_it_matters_hint: Gives women and doctors a recurrence estimate before surgery from a scan already taken.
event_date: Not stated; clearance and study reported 15 Oct 2026
notes: FDA clearance date not given in the article. Study data were previously collected (retrospective).
